channel.title: Irfan Zaki: posts
channel.description: Notes on AWS, Terraform, networks and shipping things, from a cloud and platform engineer.

item.title: The 15 MB Bucket That Cost Me USD 114: Litestream, S3 LIST Calls and Vibe-Coded Defaults
item.description: Two tiny Litestream replicas ran up 928 GB of S3 data transfer in two weeks. How it happened, why no alert stopped it, how AWS waived the bill, and what I changed about building with AI.

item.title: Shipping Terraform Through a Governed Platform: Where the Time Actually Goes
item.description: A field report on a multi-environment Terraform rollout through CI-gated pipelines and shared platform modules: where the time went, the SOP that worked, and what would make it lighter.

item.title: Building Reusable Terraform Modules: From Flat to Nested Hierarchies
item.description: What I learned about Terraform module design after going from a single reusable module to a three-tier nested hierarchy: the flexibility it unlocks, and the complexity it introduces.

item.title: Amazon RDS vs RDS Custom vs Self-Managed Database on EC2: Choosing the Right Control Boundary
item.description: A practical breakdown of the three database deployment models on AWS (fully managed RDS, semi-managed RDS Custom, and self-managed on EC2), covering what each one costs in control, operational burden, and money.

item.title: AWS Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store vs Environment Variables: When to Use Which
item.description: A practical guide to choosing between environment variables, SSM Parameter Store, and AWS Secrets Manager, covering cost, rotation, audit, and the cases where each one is the wrong tool.

item.title: Terraform Remote State: S3 Only vs S3 + DynamoDB Locking
item.description: A practical breakdown of Terraform remote state on AWS: when S3 alone is enough and when DynamoDB state locking is worth the added complexity.

item.title: Automating Windows EC2 Patching with Lambda, EventBridge, and SSM Automation
item.description: How I replaced a years-old manual Windows EC2 patching ritual (RDP in, download the KB, patch, reboot, and sanity check) with a fully automated pipeline using Lambda, EventBridge, and an SSM Automation Document.

item.title: E2E IaC for Multi-AZ Production VPC
item.description: A practical walkthrough of the three foundational decisions in a production-grade VPC: the public/private subnet pattern, NAT strategy tradeoffs, and where to place ALB.

item.title: Migrating On-Prem Apps to AWS: A Real Architecture Walkthrough
item.description: A practical guide to migrating on-premises applications to AWS, covering a pre-migration assessment checklist, structuring migration waves, and the networking pitfalls that catch most teams off guard.

item.title: Secure SSH Access Through a Bastion Host Without Storing the Private Key
item.description: Learn how to securely SSH into a private target server through a bastion host by forwarding private key using SSH agent forwarding, avoiding key exposure on the bastion host.

item.title: Simplifying AWS Account Management with AWS Organizations and Identity Center
item.description: Simplifies AWS account management with centralized control, consolidated billing, and a setup guide for effective management.

item.title: Web-App Deployment using PM2 in AWS
item.description: Configuring web-app deployment using PM2 in EC2 utilizing launch template, and semi CI/CD implementation using S3.
